answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 34988 Country: India Title: My question is on which cost of gold either the cost of today market purchasing rates or on the rates of gold sell I have to pay the zakah Question: My question is on which cost of gold either the cost of today market purchasing rates or on the rates of gold sell I have to pay the zakah? For example, if I have 10 gm of gold the today's market price is Rs.28000.00 approx. And if I am going to sell this gold the shopkeeper purchases not more than Rs.27000.00. So on which cost of gold I may pay the zakah on Rs. 28000.00 or on Rs.27000.00? Answer ID: 34988 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1841/1159/D=1432) You will have to pay your zakah on 28000 as per the market rate. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
